magicText.exactBoundaryRule: Use half-open ranges except the final endpoint; at 1 the leaving main body is hidden.
magicText.reverse: The same scroll position restores the same narrative camera/text state; environmental particles need not rewind.
magicText.continuity: Adjacent stations share a continuous downward path across the previous release and next approach; no pose jump at their boundary.
magicText.ambient: Subtle edge particles may use environment time; main glyph visibility and reading brightness follow narrative progress.
magicText.reducedMotion: Stable chapter poses and readable content, direct chapter navigation; suppress decorative particles and continuous camera travel.

acceptance.criterion: Complete route from overview through all three columns to water and closing.
Ten unique reading stations with column, anchor, copy/status, presentation and scroll allocation.
All stage budgets contiguous, total 12.3H, with entry/read/release behavior specified.
Reading heights inside current shafts; travel intentions specified, future camera validation explicit.
Deep-column/light-magic-text visual roles and synchronized reveal rules documented.
Fast scroll, reverse scroll, navigation, viewport changes and media return have explicit behavior.
Owner facts, genuine existing media, generated samples and missing content remain distinct.
Step 2 has an actionable brief; application source, dependencies, media, builds and archives unchanged.
